definitions.definition: In the shorter Sanskrit recension: Avalokiteśvara sees the five aggregates as empty of own-being (svabhāva-śūnya); form is emptiness and emptiness form, and likewise vedanā, saṃjñā, saṃskāra and vijñāna; all dharmas have the mark of emptiness, unarisen, unceased; in emptiness there are no aggregates, sense-bases, realms, links, truths, knowledge or attainment.
